hook: Euclid, printed in red, yellow and blue.

beats.say: Open any edition of Euclid printed between fourteen eighty-two and eighteen forty-six, and you meet the same sentence thousands of times over.
Oliver Byrne's eighteen forty-seven edition changed that: the triangle has no letters on it, one side red, one yellow, one blue.
Byrne was born in eighteen ten in County Wicklow, and his book taught geometry as pictures, not as a spelling exercise.
